messages.text: BL-1727 🎵 in progress — extension/test/bl1703OllamaLaunchProbe.property.test.js failed at load ~11 (QA, BL-1720's parcel d24e8d4b0c): 'expected pid 7123 to be stopped' after a refused launch - ollama_ancillary_lib.sh's ollama_ancillary_stop_pid sends one TERM and returns at once, so the refused launch (BL-1703) and the swarm's stop paths (BL-1704) report a started ollama server stopped while it may still be running; the helper waits, bounded, for the pid to exit, escalates to KILL, and fails naming the pid if even that does not end it
